instruction: Review hard-01_seed.dxf. Launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `hard-01_seed.dxf`. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'rounded fixture datum plate with paired slots' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (18,0)->(202,0); OUTLINE (220,18)->(220,122); OUTLINE (202,140)->(18,140); OUTLINE (0,122)->(0,18); CENTER (0,70)->(220,70); CENTER (110,0)->(110,140); CUTOUT (52,40)->(88,40); CUTOUT (52,30)->(88,30); CUTOUT (132,110)->(168,110); CUTOUT (132,100)->(168,100). Required circles: HOLE center (30,30) radius 6; HOLE center (190,30) radius 6; HOLE center (30,110) radius 6; HOLE center (190,110) radius 6; HOLE center (75,70) radius 8; HOLE center (145,70) radius 8; CUTOUT center (110,70) radius 24. Required arcs: OUTLINE center (18,18) radius 18 start 180 end 270; OUTLINE center (202,18) radius 18 start 270 end 0; OUTLINE center (202,122) radius 18 start 0 end 90; OUTLINE center (18,122) radius 18 start 90 end 180; CUTOUT center (52,35) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (88,35) radius 5 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (132,105) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (168,105) radius 5 start 270 end 90. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H01; ANNOTATION text DATUM A. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
